description: Third-party SaaS / cloud endpoints that can be claimed by an attacker when a DNS record still points at them. Used by secaudit for dangling-CNAME and subdomain-takeover detection. Suffixes are matched on a label boundary (evil-github.io does NOT match github.io).

unclaimed_signatures: There isn't a GitHub Pages site here
For root URLs (like http://example.com/) you must provide an index.html file
services.notes: Create a GitHub Pages site with the custom domain, or delete the DNS record.

unclaimed_signatures: The specified bucket does not exist
services.notes: Re-create the bucket with the exact name, or remove the record. CNAMEs to unclaimed bucket names are trivially takeover-able.

unclaimed_signatures: There is no app configured at that hostname
services.notes: Claim the app name in a Heroku account you control, otherwise the hostname is free for anyone.

unclaimed_signatures: The requested app is not available
services.notes: Azure resource names are global. An unclaimed cloudapp.net / azurewebsites.net target is claimable by anyone.

unclaimed_signatures: Sorry, this shop is currently unavailable
services.notes: Shop domain names are first-come-first-served; an unclaimed myshopify handle can be registered by an attacker.
Add the hostname to a Fastly service you own, or delete the DNS record.
Claim the site name in Netlify and add the custom domain.

unclaimed_signatures: The deployment could not be found on Vercel
services.notes: Vercel project names are global; claim the project or remove the record.
Surge projects are published by name with no ownership check beyond the name itself.

unclaimed_signatures: The gods are wise, but do not know of the site which you seek
services.notes: Re-add the domain to a Pantheon site, or remove the DNS record.

unclaimed_signatures: Whatever you were looking for doesn't currently exist at this address
services.notes: Tumblr blogs can be registered by name; an unclaimed blog leaves the custom domain dangling.
Unclaimed *.wordpress.com subdomains can be registered by anyone with the same slug.

unclaimed_signatures: This help center no longer exists
services.notes: Zendesk subdomains are claimed at signup; a closed help centre frees the name.
Support portals are addressed by subdomain; an unclaimed one can be recreated.

unclaimed_signatures: The requested URL was not found on this server
The requested URL / was not found on this server
services.notes: Landing pages are served from unbouncepages.com; delete the domain from Unbounce before removing the page.
Bitbucket static sites live on *.bitbucket.io; an unclaimed workspace name is registerable.
Remove the custom domain from Ghost before shutting the publication down.

unclaimed_signatures: The page you were looking for doesn't exist
services.notes: Documentation projects are addressed by subdomain and can be recreated by an attacker.
Publish or re-claim the Webflow project, or delete the DNS record.

unclaimed_signatures: The page you were looking for doesn't exist
services.notes: Status pages are addressed by subdomain; cancelled accounts free the subdomain.
Feedback boards are addressed by subdomain and can be recreated.

unclaimed_signatures: This UserVoice subdomain is currently available!
services.notes: UserVoice explicitly announces available subdomains — a direct takeover indicator.

unclaimed_signatures: This help center is not currently available
This help center is not available
services.notes: Knowledge bases are addressed by subdomain; delete the domain in Helpjuice before cancelling.

unclaimed_signatures: No site found for this domain
services.notes: Remove the custom domain from the Kinsta environment before deleting the site.

unclaimed_signatures: The site you are looking for could not be found
services.notes: Acquia sites are addressed by technical domain; remove the DNS record when decommissioning.

unclaimed_signatures: The specified bucket does not exist
services.notes: Spaces and App Platform apps use global names; re-create or remove the record.

unclaimed_signatures: The specified bucket does not exist.
services.notes: GCS bucket names are global; a deleted bucket name can be claimed by anyone.
Firebase site IDs are global; claim the site or delete the DNS record.

unclaimed_signatures: The requested URL was not found on this server
services.notes: App Engine application IDs are global and cannot be re-created after deletion — remove stale DNS.
Cargo sites are addressed by subdomain; unclaimed names are available to anyone.

unclaimed_signatures: This shop is not currently available
services.notes: Store subdomains are first-come-first-served.
Remove the custom domain from Instapage before deleting the landing page.

unclaimed_signatures: The page you are looking for doesn't exist
services.notes: Email link-tracking CNAMEs are frequently left behind after a SendGrid account is closed.
